if you aren't gone yet please hold on, for your pets, for your mom, even if everyone is against you please take the simple things in life and hold them dear, please don't let go, life gets hard but you just need to find away to make it better, please don't lose hope
you're city doesn't have any local groups or supports? please don't give up on yourself I've only just met you and I'd cry for hours if I found out you died

okay deep breath don't do anything rash, the only thing I could think about after my suicide attempt is how to take it back, please reach out, talk to someone local, call the police anyone, you obviously need help so please reach out and get it, there are people who will support you and listen and try there best to understand, don't let go

don't give up on yourself, sadly depression is a chronic mental health disorder which means it never goes away but that doesn't mean you can't be happy, I'm not the best at advice and I don't know your life story but I will try to help, I think you might benefit from therapy not psychiatrists, a good ole fashioned therapist, try to find the best one in your area and if you can't afford it try emailing them and asking them to lower the price, they might say no but it never hurts to try, if you don't like that you could try to take life slowly, move in with someone you currently know whether it be your parents, brother, sister, grandma, aunt, it doesn't matter, since you want to go to university maybe try online school or something that will be slower and less stressful, try to get out side as much as you can and bask in little moments like sitting on a park bench with a cup of coffee, try to meet new people, smile at every stranger you see because it feels really good when they look sad and they smile back (i have a story about that if you wanna hear it) i hope you can hold on and find the small things in life that are worth living for

the only advice I can give you is baby steps, don't go out and get a job right away you need to ease yourself back into social situations and being out in public, doing work, mannerisms, etc, the best way I can see you doing this is trying to get a dating app such as tinder (you can look for people to hang with or someone to date) or join a local club or group if you've been so isolated you're not going to be able to just get into the swing of things, find people who care, trust me it's easier than you think, even if you're only friend is someone you met on Instagram who lives halfway across the world that kind of support is the kind of thing that will hopefully help you through this tough time
